source.name: recettear-mods
source.description: Mods for Recettear on the Recettear Mod Loader.

mods.name: Display Settings
mods.description: A Display Settings page in the game's own Options (title and pause): display mode, resolution, aspect / widescreen, backgrounds, HUD anchor, render scale, VSYNC, frame rate (interpolated above 60). Applies live through the loader's graphics layer; saved in rml_mods.cfg.

versions.notes: Display Settings page in the game's Options (title and pause): display mode, resolution, aspect / widescreen, backgrounds, HUD anchor, render scale, VSYNC, frame rate (60 stock, or interpolated up to the display's refresh rate). Applies live.

mods.name: First Person
mods.description: A first-person camera in the shop's own Button-4 cycle (retail → retail low → [Free] → First Person → retail): eyes at Recette's head, mouse look, WASD walking relative to the view, left click = confirm, right click / Tab = menu. Recette's own sprite and shadow are hidden. Hands back to the game camera in cinematics (counter, decorating, day end).

versions.notes: First-person view in the shop (Button 4 cycles to it): eyes at Recette's head, mouse look at the display's refresh rate, WASD, left click = confirm, right click / Tab = menu. Settings: field of view, sensitivity, invert Y.

mods.name: Free Camera
mods.description: An extra camera in the shop's own Button-4 cycle (retail → retail low → Free → retail): turn, zoom and raise the view; walking stays camera-relative like retail's own camera. Hands back to the game camera in cinematics (counter, decorating, day end).

versions.notes: A free orbit camera as an extra entry in the shop's Button-4 camera cycle: rotate, zoom, height (keys, right-drag, pad). Cutscenes hand back to the game's camera.

mods.name: Rebalance + QoL
mods.description: Explains the rules the game hides and removes friction that isn't a decision; balance options are off unless you pick them. In development: this version has the customer ledger with deal history (pause menu), the deal result line, trip times on the town map, order reminders, the buying / selling banner and save protection. Every change is a row on its own Options page. Saves stay vanilla.

versions.notes: In development, feedback wanted. Information only, nothing in the simulation changes: an Options page with presets (Rebalanced / Classic+ / Off) and one row per change; a customer ledger in the pause menu (reputation level and points, optional budgets) with the prices each customer has accepted from you; a result line after each offer (reputation, EXP, combo, and why); what a trip really costs on the town map; order reminders and an order tracker; a buying / selling banner on the price dial; save protection (save screens start on this game's file or an empty one, and warn before writing over another game).

mods.name: Unlock Menu
mods.description: The full title menu whatever the saves hold: all 8 entries; NEW GAME + and SURVIVAL MODE from any slot (an empty slot = a fresh start). Writes nothing to save.dat.

versions.notes: The full title menu whatever the saves hold: all 8 entries; New Game+ and Survival from any slot (an empty slot = a fresh start). Writes nothing to save.dat.

mods.name: Wardrobe
mods.description: Recolour Recette by region — hair, eyes, skin, shirt, top, tie, apron, skirt, hair bobbles, boots & belt — everywhere she appears (field sprite, portraits, the kneeling chibi, the pause art). Presets or your own #RRGGBB per region, live from a Wardrobe page in the pause / title Options. Masks are built on your PC from your own game files at load, from shipped colour rules: no pixels shipped.

versions.notes: Recolour Recette (hair, eyes, clothes: 10 regions) from an Options page: presets or per-region colours, live preview. Works on your own game files at load time; nothing is written to the game folder.
